file_id: D.S.Spiceco Pvt. Ltd. & Anr vs State Of West Bengal & Ors on 20 March, 2017

sentences.text: D.S.Spiceco Pvt. Ltd. & Anr vs State Of West Bengal & Ors

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak

1
20.03.2017.
 rc
 W.P. No.4376(W) of 2017
 D.S.Spiceco Pvt. Ltd. & Anr.
 Versus
 State of West Bengal & Ors.

For the petitioner
 Mr.Jayanta Majumder .. For the respondent no.11
Mr. B. Ahmed ..

For the State An order appealable under the provision of the Food Safety and
Standard Act is under challenge in the present writ petition.

During the pendency of the writ
petition, the petitioner has filed an appeal.
Learned advocate for the petitioner submits that although the appeal was taken on record and a receipt has been issued by the Registrar, the appeal number has not been provided.
She seeks that the writ petition may be kept pending.
The State and the respondent no. 11 are represented.
Since the impugned order is appealable and the petitioner has already availed of the statutory alternative remedy, it would not be appropriate to keep the writ petition pending.
Pendency of this writ petition will impede the hearing of the appeal filed.
In such circumstances W.P.No. 4376(W) of 2017 is disposed of without any order as to costs.
Urgent certified website copies of this order, if applied for, be made available to the parties upon compliance of the requisite formalities.

(Debangsu Basak, J.)
